sources.note: Official NYC DOT Fulton Street bus and pedestrian project source. It identifies B25/B26 with Fulton Street bus-lane proposals, but it does not name B69 and therefore cannot transfer Fulton lane service or traversal to the candidate route.

Official NYC DOT adjacent-project presentation used only for nonterminal B69 intersection-endpoint context. It names the B69 on Vanderbilt Avenue and gives Fulton Street as the endpoint of the Vanderbilt/Clermont proposal; it does not state that B69 served or traversed the Fulton Street bus lanes, the exact 33 feature-row occurrences, their directions, phase, extent, or June 1 onset.
